description: Can release a wave of willpower that knocks out weaker people nearby.
Can coat attacks with Conqueror's Haki, hitting without touching. Only the strongest fighters in the world learn it.
Has fully mastered Conqueror's Haki: can dominate battlefields, overwhelm other Conqueror users and clash with the strongest people alive.
Can coat the body or a weapon with an invisible armour that hardens it and lets the user hit Logia users.
Can blacken the body, emit Haki outward to destroy from the inside, and strike enemies from a distance.
Has fully mastered Armament Haki: can destroy from the inside with a touch and break through almost any defence.
Can sense the presence, emotions and intentions of people nearby and read their attacks.
Can sense across whole islands and briefly see into the future.
Has fully mastered Observation Haki: can see far into the future and sense the whole battlefield at once.
